title: Overflowing bins beside public market
description: Garbage bags and mixed waste are spilling from three full community bins onto the footpath.

title: Waste pile blocking storm drain
description: A large waste pile is covering the roadside drain and may cause waterlogging during rain.

title: Overflowing bin near bus stop
description: One public bin is overflowing near the bus stop; litter is spreading into the pedestrian area.

title: Garbage not collected for two days
description: Household waste has accumulated at the collection point and is attracting stray animals.

title: Market waste spilling onto road
description: Vegetable waste from the market collection area is spreading onto the road and producing a strong smell.

title: Broken bin lid and scattered rubbish
description: A damaged public bin lid leaves rubbish exposed and scattered across the nearby walkway.

title: Deep pothole at junction
description: A deep pothole occupies part of the turning lane and causes two-wheelers to swerve into traffic.

title: Cracked road surface near school
description: The road surface is breaking apart near the school entrance where children cross each morning.

title: Pothole growing after rainfall
description: A pothole has widened after recent rain and is difficult to see when filled with water.

title: Loose paving at pedestrian crossing
description: Several road-edge pavers are loose near the crossing and create a tripping risk.

title: Road subsidence near manhole
description: The surface around a manhole is sinking, leaving a sharp depression in the vehicle lane.

title: Small crack in residential lane
description: A narrow crack has appeared along the road edge; no immediate obstruction has been reported.

title: Water main leaking near bus stand
description: Water is flowing continuously from a suspected underground main leak and flooding the bus-stop approach.

title: Pipe leak outside school gate
description: A pipe leak creates a muddy pool beside the school gate and makes the walking path slippery.

title: Water escaping from roadside valve
description: Water continues to seep from a roadside valve and is flowing toward a storm drain.

title: Burst pipe causing road flooding
description: A burst pipe has flooded one side of the street and reduced safe access for pedestrians.

title: Slow leak at public tap
description: A public tap connection drips continuously and creates a small puddle near the pavement.

title: Drainage water mixing with leak
description: A suspected water-pipe leak is mixing with dirty standing water near a busy pedestrian path; inspection is needed.

title: Streetlights out along park road
description: Three consecutive streetlights are not working, leaving a long section of the road dark at night.

title: Streetlight broken at crossing
description: The lamp at a busy pedestrian crossing is off, reducing visibility for people crossing after sunset.

title: Flickering lamp near apartments
description: A streetlight flickers intermittently on the residential lane and sometimes goes completely dark.

title: Dark stretch near school route
description: Two streetlights are out along a route used by students and pedestrians in the early morning.

title: Lamp damaged by fallen branch
description: A streetlight fixture appears damaged after a branch fell nearby; the light is no longer working.

title: Single streetlight not working
description: One streetlight is not illuminating the footpath; nearby lights remain operational.
